definitionZh: CSS 属性用于定义 HTML 内容的表达方式。 所列举的一到三个关键术语决定了元件和文本通过屏幕阅读器和数字助理等人工技术获得的方式.
sourceDefinition: The speak-as CSS property is used to define how HTML content is spoken. The one to three enumerated key terms determine the manner by which elements and text get rendered by aural technologies, such as screen reader and digital assistants.
